title: Ahmedabad Urban Scanner

gtfs_service_intensity.method: S_i = sum_r F_ir, counting GTFS stop_times departures at stop i for the whole service day and the half-open peak windows 08:00–10:00 and 17:00–19:00; average departures per hour divides whole-day departures by the observed service-day span.

transit_isochrones.method: Selected stop plus stops within a 5-minute prepared-street-network walk; all stops on routes serving those seeds; 15-minute prepared-street-network walking catchment from each route stop.
transit_isochrones.stop_route_service: Each stop entry is [routeIndex, averageHeadwayMinutesOrNull, hourlyCounts]; counts are scheduled departures per service hour and headways use consecutive unique departure times.
transit_isochrones.cell_area: area_m2 is measured on each projected catchment cell before WGS84 conversion.

unverified-height.caveat: Height-dependent raster is published for inspection but has not been validated for this study; do not treat it as verified evidence.

modelled-building-height.caveat: Google Research Open Buildings Temporal modelled height; not surveyed height. 30 m overview switches to the detailed tile pyramid at zoom 8; source effective resolution is ~4 m, source storage grid is 0.5 m, and presence threshold is 0.2.

scope-unverified.caveat: Scope, provenance, and temporal status are not verified.

supplied-unverified-experimental.caveat: Supplied development-plan visual context from ARPM Studio, Development Plan for Ahmedabad 2041; provenance, accuracy, and temporal currency are not verified. It is not analytical evidence.

analysis_status: Published products mix full-study current results, bounded current-study subsets, sampled current-study model outputs, morphology proxies, archived/historical pilot outputs, contextual external layers, supplied external layers, scenario products, and unverified products; each item must be interpreted using its displayed provenance context. Space syntax was not rerun; the supplied clipped external layer is published as raw fields.

transitIsochrones.title: 15-minute route-reach walking catchment
transitIsochrones.caveat: Route-reach catchment, not total public-transport journey time: select a stop, add stops within a 5-minute walk on the prepared street network, include every stop on their GTFS routes, then union 15-minute street-network walking catchments around those route stops. Waiting and in-vehicle times are not constrained. Feed provenance remains unresolved.

developmentPlan.title: Development plan
developmentPlan.caveat: Supplied visual raster with its own embedded legend and north arrow; provenance, accuracy, and temporal currency are unverified. No separate analytical colour scale is claimed.

source.interpretation: Visual contextual material only. Do not classify, recolor, crop, or treat as verified analytical evidence.

classification_note: Data-derived quantiles use up to seven classes with interior i/N thresholds and duplicate thresholds removed; connectivity uses exact categories, constant fields are marked as having no variation, and missing values are neutral gray.
interpretation: Building footprints are Google Open Buildings V3 detections, not cadastral or occupancy records.
The supplied GTFS feed is published as provided and requires provenance confirmation before analytical use.
Transit service intensity provides mutually exclusive whole-day, 08:00–10:00, 17:00–19:00, and average-departures-per-hour views; route count is a separate attribute and is not treated as frequency.

The route-reach walking catchment is not a timetable-constrained transit isochrone: it expands from the selected stop and nearby stops to every stop on their routes, then applies a 15-minute street-network walk around each route stop.
PlanX outputs are pilot diagnostics; space syntax was not rerun in this session.

development_plan_publication.interpretation: Visual contextual material only. Do not classify, recolor, crop, or treat as verified analytical evidence.

ahmedabad_boundary_publication.method: Copied every polygon exterior shell only; interior rings were intentionally omitted; no simplification or coordinate transformation was applied.
